Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

def transform(grid):
    # Two equal-width binary panels are separated by a solid colored column.
    # Keep positions occupied in both panels and encode them as color 2.
    sep = next(c for c, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if all(row[c] == 6 for row in grid))
    width = sep
    right = sep + 1
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][right + c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(grid))]
